{{Quote|Assaulting a Royal Naboo station... what if that creates a political firestorm?''"<br />"''They're hiding Rebel traitors there. That makes them traitors in the eyes of the Empire. It's been double-checked this time by Imperial intelligence. Besides, we have our mission. I'm not a politician.|A storm commando and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]]|<ref name="TotC" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''mission''' was carried out by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]]'s [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During an [[Mission to Rori (Storm commandos)|assault]] on a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], the storm commandos discovered information about a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RNSF]] station used as a front for the Rebellion on Naboo. The Imperial troops attacked the station and fought Royal Naboo soldiers along with [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]'s [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|troops]]. The storm commandos eventually overcame their enemies, forcing Garm Bel Iblis to flee. After the assault, the Imperial troops searched the station and discovered information about a Rebel base on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TotC" />
